releases.body:
## Continuous review and demo movie — September 9

**[Watch/download the single complete movie](https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef/releases/download/day1-world-animation-audit-2026-09-09/MERMAID_ROSHAN_DAY_ONE_REVIEW_DEMO_2026-09-09.mp4)** — 2:17.667, 720p/24fps, with music, ambience, cleaning foley and 18 complete existing Roshan lines.

Otter opening → castle rooms and rescues → team dust-bunny cleanup → locked rainbow-friend reveal → everyone cleans the castle → clean-room recap and family hug.

[Edit and review notes](https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef/releases/download/day1-world-animation-audit-2026-09-09/DAY_ONE_REVIEW_DEMO_NOTES.md) · [Editable package: conformed clips, sound stems, mix and Resolve XML](https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef/releases/download/day1-world-animation-audit-2026-09-09/DAY_ONE_REVIEW_DEMO_EDIT_PACKAGE_2026-09-09.zip)

Rough cinematic montage, not a gameplay playthrough or production-final acceptance. The failed double-invitation and extra-bird setups are omitted. Existing C13/C14 hard-cut limitations and inherited continuity issues remain explicit in the notes. Resolve XML is not import-tested; this new conform used FFmpeg on existing DaVinci edits and reviewed inserts. Original release assets and prior QC remain below, unchanged.

---

# Latest QC — response batch uploaded at 16:20 UTC

The new response has been checked. All six supplied trims match the requested video frame ranges. Two replacement shots still need regeneration: **C14-S01 adds a second bird** (six actors by frame24), and **D1-C02-R02 lights the art palette alongside the bathroom pearls**.

- [Latest shot-by-shot review and remaining refinements](https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef/releases/download/day1-world-animation-audit-2026-09-09/QC_RESPONSE_REVIEW_2026-09-09.md)
- [Current edit recommendations](https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef/releases/download/day1-world-animation-audit-2026-09-09/QC_RESPONSE_REVIEW
